name: dejaaa-usdc
notes: NOT LIVE: do not deposit into, borrow from or loop against this pool until its contracts appear in mainnet.jsonl and the launch is announced.

oracle: reuses the Templar runtime deployed with xlm-usdc (set oracle.runtime to its id before deploying; USDC is already registered there). deJAAA is priced by the RedStone wrapper alone (12 h heartbeat or 0.25% move), hence the 13 h max age.
admin is a temporary operator key; it hands over to the final admin with the pool's two-step propose_admin/accept_admin transfer.
pool: arguments to PoolFactory.deploy (salt is chosen at deploy time). oracle is a dedicated pool_oracle_adapter.

Activate (set_status 0) only once the oracle has its full source set. set_status 0 also checks the backstop threshold; it is met by this pool's own activation stack (own factory, Comet, emissions-disabled backstop and synthetic no-value BLND/USDC legs), not real capital.
min_collateral is effective (c_factor-weighted) collateral in 7-decimal oracle base units: 10000000000 = 1,000 USD.
usdc IRM (fixed, reactivity 0): flat 3.3% up to U=90%, 13.3% at 95%, 23.3% at 100%. The kink above 90% is there because reserve configs freeze after setup.
dejaaa is a custom Soroban token (Centrifuge wrapped AAA CLO, not a SAC); 18 decimals per its on-chain decimals(). Collateral only; r_base 1000 is the contract minimum. min_position = 1 deJAAA.
supply_cap is i128::MAX: no on-chain cap, and it can never be lowered. The pilot limit is enforced in the app only.

On chain a borrow only needs health factor >= 1.00001, so the 93.5% max-borrow LTV is app-enforced; a direct contract call can borrow up to the 95% liquidation LTV. Liquidation incentive tops out at (1 - c_factor) / 2 = 2.5%.
